title_translated: 追踪大语言模型中的知识与推理
summary_translated: 当前对大语言模型（LLMs）的评估通常停留在数据集或任务层面，仅展示模型的表现结果，却难以揭示其性能背后内部处理过程的细节。为此，我们提出一种以任务为中心的框架，用于刻画基准测试所激发的模型内部处理机制。该框架融合注意力信号、激活信号与表示度量，覆盖从以检索为主到以推理为主的连续谱系，并揭示任务层面评分所掩盖的失败模式。我们在24个多样化基准上评估了16个LLMs，并对代表性模型与任务进行针对性的内部状态分析，观察到知识导向任务与推理导向任务之间存在系统性处理差异。我们推动评估范式从‘模型取得了什么分数’转向‘该分数对应何种处理模式’，这有助于更精准地选择基准并做出更明智的模型选型。相关代码已开源至 https://github.com/extraordinarylab/trace-kr。

summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly relies on a harness, the scaffold around the model that decides what it sees of its own interaction and what guidance it receives. Most existing approaches train under a hand-written harness that stays fixed throughout. However, an effective harness depends on the domain, the data and the model, and keeps changing as the model trains. We introduce ModHarness-RL, which recasts the harness as programs that are learned from data and evolve as the model trains with RL. ModHarness-RL records the interaction as structured State, a set of typed blocks, and two core components of the harness are programs over these blocks, a Compression program that assembles the accumulated history into the model's context and a Steering program that supplies guidance when behavior deviates. During RL training, candidate programs are proposed from recent trajectories, verified by execution, and replayed over past trajectories, so the harness tracks how the model's behavior shifts. We study CodeSearch in depth and further analyze ALFWorld and BIRD SQL, with models from 1.5B to 8B. The proposed Compression and Steering mechanisms improve held-out performance over the fixed-harness baseline in most settings. These results suggest that a harness for agentic RL can be learned from the task's data and evolved with the model.
title: ModHarness-RL: Recasting Harnesses as Learnable and Evolving Programs for Agentic RL
title_translated: ModHarness-RL：将约束器重构为可学习且演化的智能体强化学习程序
summary_translated: 智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）越来越多地依赖于‘约束器’——即围绕模型构建的框架，决定模型感知自身交互的方式以及接收的指导信息。现有大多数方法采用固定的手写约束器，训练过程中保持不变。然而，有效的约束器取决于领域、数据与模型，并随模型训练不断演化。我们提出ModHarness-RL，将约束器重新定义为从数据中学习并随模型训练动态演化的程序。ModHarness-RL将交互记录为结构化状态（一组带类型的模块），其核心组件为基于这些模块的程序：压缩程序将累积的历史信息整合进模型上下文，引导程序在行为偏离时提供指导。在强化学习训练过程中，候选程序从近期轨迹中生成，经执行验证后，在历史轨迹上回放，使约束器能够跟踪模型行为的变化。我们深入研究了CodeSearch任务，并进一步分析ALFWorld与BIRD SQL任务，涵盖1.5B至8B规模的模型。所提出的压缩与引导机制在多数设置下均显著优于固定约束器基线。结果表明，智能体强化学习中的约束器可从任务数据中学习，并随模型一同演化。

summary: Wafer-scale accelerators offer massive compute capacity through hundreds of thousands of processing elements (PEs) interconnected across a single wafer, but realizing this potential requires efficient application mapping. Their scale makes programming these systems and mapping applications onto them challenging. Existing approaches rely on template-based mappings to maintain productivity, but these templates restrict the mapping design space. In particular, they impose fixed geometric layouts over the PE grid, often leaving compute and memory resources underutilized.   In this work, we present WaferTetris, a system that removes these geometric restrictions through freeform mapping. Its Tetris-like strategy flexibly packs computation across the wafer, improving PE utilization and usable memory capacity while preserving PE-task code. We develop a recurrence-based throughput model that captures branch-and-join dependencies to guide spatial parallelism, and an architecture model with per-color gates that enable existing FPGA place-and-route algorithms to enforce WSE routing constraints.   We evaluate WaferTetris on Cerebras WSE-3 using LLM decoding and scientific stencil benchmarks. For LLM decoding, it achieves up to $4.42\times$ the system throughput of a template-based automatic mapping baseline on the same fabric size. Compared with the manually optimized WaferLLM, WaferTetris supports $1.8\times$ the context length for LLaMA3.1-8B (80k versus 44k), while delivering equal or higher per-user throughput at matched context lengths, up to $1.10\times$.
title: WaferTetris: Efficient Freeform Mapping on Wafer-Scale Accelerators
title_translated: WaferTetris：晶圆级加速器上的高效自由布局映射
summary_translated: 晶圆级加速器（WSE）通过单片晶圆上数十万处理单元（PE）的互联，提供了巨大的计算能力，但要充分发挥其潜力，需要高效的程序映射。由于其规模庞大，编程及应用映射极具挑战性。现有方法依赖模板化映射以维持开发效率，但这些模板限制了映射设计空间，通常施加固定的几何布局于PE网格上，导致计算与内存资源利用率低下。本文提出WaferTetris，一种通过自由布局消除几何限制的系统。其类似俄罗斯方块的策略灵活地在晶圆上打包计算，提升PE利用率与可用内存容量，同时保留PE-任务代码。我们构建了一种基于递归的吞吐量模型，捕捉分支与合并依赖以指导空间并行；并设计了一种带有彩色门控的架构模型，使现有FPGA布局布线算法能够满足WSE的布线约束。我们在Cerebras WSE-3上对LLM解码与科学模板基准进行评估。在LLM解码任务中，WaferTetris相比模板化自动映射基线，系统吞吐量最高提升4.42倍；相较于手动优化的WaferLLM，WaferTetris支持LLaMA3.1-8B长达1.8倍的上下文长度（80k vs 44k），并在相同上下文长度下实现相等或更高的每用户吞吐量，最高达1.10倍。

summary: Mechanistic Interpretability (MI) has made significant progress in explaining the internal computations of Large Language Models (LLMs); however, these advances have yet to demonstrate comparable success in explaining the decision-making processes of LLM-based agents. This paper examines the challenges MI tools face when applied to realistic agentic failures. We focus on one such failure: web agents hallucinating actions that are not available on a website. We apply a series of mechanistic analyzes to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct as it interacts with live websites. We find that a linear probe trained on the last prompt token can predict hallucinations before generation begins (0.80 AUC) and steering along a probe direction corrects 85\% of hallucinations, but disrupts 7\% of valid actions. However, these results only provide a partial explanation of why the agent hallucinates. The probe direction is sensitive to prompt formatting, losing much of its steering effect after a minor change to how actions are represented. Additionally, circuit identification can be difficult as the computation is distributed across multiple components and positions, and the information the agent relies on varies across examples. We discuss how these observations challenge the assumptions underlying standard MI methods for circuit discovery and feature identification, and outline future directions for making these methods better suited to explain failures in LLM-based agents.
title: Can Mechanistic Interpretability Help Explain LLM Agent Failures? A Case Study on Web Element Hallucination
title_translated: 机制可解释性能否帮助解释大语言模型智能体的失败？以网页元素幻觉为例的案例研究
summary_translated: 机制可解释性（MI）在解释大语言模型（LLMs）内部计算方面已取得显著进展，但这些进展尚未在解释基于LLM的智能体决策过程方面展现出同等成效。本文探讨MI工具在应对真实智能体失败时面临的挑战。我们聚焦于一种典型失败现象：网络智能体幻觉出网站上不存在的操作。我们对Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct在与实时网站交互时进行一系列机制分析。研究发现，基于最后一个提示词训练的线性探测器可在生成开始前预测幻觉（AUC达0.80），沿探测方向进行引导可纠正85%的幻觉，但会破坏7%的有效操作。然而，这些结果仅提供了部分解释。探测方向对提示格式敏感，一旦动作表示方式发生微小变化，其引导效果便大幅减弱。此外，电路识别困难，因计算分布于多个组件与位置，且智能体依赖的信息在不同示例间差异显著。我们讨论这些观察如何挑战标准MI方法在电路发现与特征识别中的假设，并提出未来改进方向，使MI方法更适用于解释基于LLM的智能体的失败。

summary: This paper introduces MeReader, a privacy-preserving, offline and progress-aware AI assistant designed to function as a contextual companion for narrative reading on consumer hardware. Unlike conventional Large Language Model (LLM)-based systems that process documents/books online in an all-texts-at-once type of way, thereby risking narrative spoilers, MeReader confines both retrieval and generation to the reader's distinct position in the text. The system integrates a hybrid retrieval architecture, combining vector similarity, BM25, and summary embeddings, to ensure high fidelity to the reader's current context. We evaluate the system across classical English books using both quantitative comprehension metrics and qualitative LLM-based independent judging. The results identify a quality-latency frontier, showing that mid-sized local models (2b-4b) can achieve comprehension parity with larger counterparts (5b+) while maintaining acceptable response quality. Importantly, the proposed progress-aware boundary mechanism is shown to prevent future content leakage without compromising retrieval quality and correctness. These findings suggest that a localized, privacy-centric approach can augment, rather than replace, the digital reading experience, offering a good alternative to cloud-dependent services. Therein, there remains a lack of amalgamate systems which combine progress-aware, privacy-preserving, and narrative eBook reading with AI support. It is in this very gap that the development of MeReader came to be; synthesizing said strands into an offline, book-constrained assistant focused on enhancing comprehension without compromising narrative continuity or user privacy.
title: MeReader: An Offline, Privacy-Preserving, Progress-Aware AI Assistant for Narrative eBook Reading

title_translated: MeReader：一种用于叙事电子书阅读的离线、隐私保护、进度感知型AI助手
summary_translated: 本文介绍了MeReader，一种专为消费者硬件上的叙事阅读设计的隐私保护、离线且进度感知的AI助手。与传统基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统将文档/书籍一次性全部处理的方式不同，MeReader将检索和生成操作限制在读者当前所处文本位置，从而避免了情节剧透的风险。该系统采用混合检索架构，结合向量相似性、BM25和摘要嵌入，确保对读者当前上下文的高度忠实。我们通过定量理解度指标和定性LLM独立评估，在经典英文书籍上对系统进行了评估。结果揭示了一个质量-延迟权衡边界，表明中等规模本地模型（2b-4b）可在保持可接受响应质量的同时，达到与更大模型（5b+）相当的理解水平。尤为重要的是，所提出的进度感知边界机制被证明能有效防止未来内容泄露，同时不损害检索质量和正确性。这些发现表明，局部化、以隐私为中心的方法可以增强而非取代数字阅读体验，为依赖云端服务提供了良好替代方案。目前仍缺乏将进度感知、隐私保护与AI支持相结合的综合性系统。正是在此空白中，MeReader应运而生；它将上述要素融合为一个离线、书籍受限的助手，专注于提升理解力，同时不破坏叙事连贯性或用户隐私。

summary: Anomaly detection in tabular data poses significant challenges due to heterogeneous feature types-mixing numerical, categorical, and textual attributes, which complicate learning meaningful representations of normality. Recent work has applied large language models (LLMs) to this problem by serializing table rows as text sequences, yet these approaches rely on one-shot supervised fine-tuning that offers limited signal to tighten the model's description of normality. We propose DiSPaT, a self-play fine-tuning framework that strengthens the model's understanding of normal data. Building on the theoretical foundation of f-divergence minimization, we derive a tight approximation connecting our training objective to reducing the distributional gap between real normal data and model-generated samples. DiSPaT operates through an alternating optimization: at each iteration, the current policy generates synthetic samples that serve as pseudo-anomalies, while a critic discriminator learns to distinguish these from real normal samples; this signal drives policy updates that progressively align the model distribution with the true normal-data distribution. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that DiSPaT consistently outperforms prior LLM-based methods, deep learning approaches, and classical unsupervised detectors for tabular anomaly detection.
title: f-Divergence Self-Play for Tabular Anomaly Detection via Large Language Models
title_translated: 基于f-散度自对弈的大语言模型表格式异常检测
summary_translated: 表格式数据中的异常检测面临显著挑战，主要源于异构特征类型——包括数值、类别和文本属性的混合，这使得学习正常状态的有意义表示变得复杂。近期研究尝试将大语言模型（LLMs）应用于该问题，通过将表格行序列化为文本序列，但这些方法依赖于一次性的监督微调，提供的信号有限，难以强化模型对正常状态的描述。我们提出DiSPaT，一种自对弈微调框架，旨在增强模型对正常数据的理解。基于f-散度最小化的理论基础，我们推导出一个紧密近似，将训练目标与缩小真实正常数据分布与模型生成样本分布之间的差距相联系。DiSPaT通过交替优化运行：每轮迭代中，当前策略生成合成样本作为伪异常，而批评者判别器则学习区分这些样本与真实正常样本；这一信号驱动策略更新，逐步使模型分布逼近真实的正常数据分布。在多种基准上的大量实验表明，DiSPaT持续优于先前的基于LLM的方法、深度学习方法以及经典无监督检测器。

summary: The release of GPT-6 Astra marks the emergence of a new paradigm in robotics: agentic robotics. Within weeks, frontier models with agentic harnesses matched or exceeded task-specific policies on many embodied benchmarks. Instead of training a dedicated policy for each family of tasks, an agentic robotic system applies a foundation model to open-world embodied tasks. It operates in a closed loop: observing the environment, interpreting user intent, reasoning about the task, invoking skills and tools, verifying outcomes, and adapting its strategy. Despite these advances, the community has yet to converge on a shared definition, a reliable evaluation framework, or a research roadmap. We argue that Embodied System 2, realized by a foundation model together with an embodied harness, forms the decision-making core of agentic robotics. Its central challenge is to translate general-purpose reasoning into effective and verifiable actions under physical constraints such as limited reaction time, mechanical limits, unpredictable environment changes, and irreversible consequences. Motivated by this perspective, we propose an evaluation framework that measures both model capabilities and closed-loop system performance. Furthermore, we identify the principles that carry over from digital to physical agents and the challenges that must be addressed to achieve reliable physical autonomy. On top of the Embodied System 2 and the evaluation framework, we envision a research roadmap toward sustained autonomy: the ability to perform work safely and reliably with progressively broader responsibility, from executing individual primitives to fulfilling standing roles.
title: Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
title_translated: 展望代理机器人：机器人系统的新时代
summary_translated: GPT-6 Astra的发布标志着机器人领域新范式的出现：代理机器人。在数周内，具备代理能力的前沿模型在许多具身基准测试中已达到甚至超越了特定任务策略的表现。代理机器人系统不再为每类任务训练专用策略，而是利用基础模型应对开放世界中的具身任务。其运行模式为闭环：观察环境、解读用户意图、推理任务、调用技能与工具、验证结果并调整策略。尽管取得进展，学界尚未就统一定义、可靠评估框架或研究路线图达成共识。我们认为，由基础模型与具身适配器共同实现的‘具身系统2’构成了代理机器人的决策核心。其核心挑战在于如何在物理约束（如反应时间有限、机械极限、环境变化不可预测、后果不可逆）下，将通用推理转化为有效且可验证的动作。基于此视角，我们提出一个评估框架，用于衡量模型能力与闭环系统性能。此外，我们识别出从数字代理向物理代理迁移的通用原则，以及实现可靠物理自主必须解决的挑战。在此基础上，我们构想了一条通往持续自主的研究路线：即在逐步扩大责任范围的过程中，安全可靠地执行工作，从执行单一基本操作到承担持续角色。

summary: Speech applications require decisions about term presence, turn completion, and language within an audio window. We present Marimba, an interface for typed speech decisions built on frozen Qwen3-ASR 0.6B features. Lexical questions use zero-shot scoring of ASR transcripts; non-lexical questions use a question-conditioned head and a separate layer-18 turn-end readout. Language identification uses the ASR model's own language scores. On private conversational test sets, decoder AUROC is 0.80-0.92; on public read speech it is 0.92-0.97. Speech Commands four-way accuracy is 0.93; binary lexical ECE is at most 0.08. Personal-information detection, which passes the greedy transcript to a private, curated PII pipeline, reaches item-level F1 0.904 on synthetic Brazilian Portuguese speech (1.000 on reference transcripts). Layer-12 speaker readouts detect speaker change with AUROC 0.966-0.980 on AMI and VoxConverse, above an ECAPA baseline, and count speakers (0, 1, 2, or 3+) more accurately than pyannote 3.1. The turn-end readout reaches AUROC 0.930 versus Smart Turn v3.2 at 0.982 on Smart Turn's own test set. On a subset of ICSI meetings labeled by next speaker, AUROC is 0.716 versus 0.712; the paired confidence interval includes zero.
title: Marimba: A System One Model for Speech

title_translated: Marimba：一种语音的系统一模型
summary_translated: 语音应用需要在音频窗口内做出关于术语存在性、对话回合完成情况及语言类型的决策。我们提出了Marimba，一个基于冻结的Qwen3-ASR 0.6B特征构建的文本化语音决策接口。对于词汇性问题，采用ASR转录本的零样本评分；对于非词汇性问题，使用条件化问题的头部和单独的第18层回合结束读出模块。语言识别则利用ASR模型自身的语言得分。在私有对话测试集上，解码器AUROC为0.80–0.92；在公开朗读语音测试中为0.92–0.97。语音命令四分类准确率为0.93；二元词汇性ECE最高为0.08。个人身份信息检测通过将贪婪转录本传递给私有的、经过筛选的PII管道，实现了在合成巴西葡萄牙语语音上的项目级F1值0.904（参考转录本为1.000）。第12层说话人读出模块在AMI和VoxConverse数据集上检测说话人切换的AUROC为0.966–0.980，优于ECAPA基线，并且比pyannote 3.1更准确地统计说话人数（0、1、2或3+）。回合结束读出模块在Smart Turn自己的测试集上，AUROC达0.930，而Smart Turn v3.2为0.982。在ICSI会议的一个子集上（由下一说话人标注），AUROC为0.716，对比0.712，配对置信区间包含零。

summary: AI judges, models that grade another system's output against a rubric, extend clinical review to the scale at which clinical AI writes. When teams use judge assessments to select a prompt or train a model, the judge becomes part of the intervention. Selection can then favor errors the judge overlooks. We describe what a judge's report must contain and the independent clinical test each judge-driven change needs.
title: When evaluation becomes intervention in clinical AI

title_translated: 当评估变为临床AI中的干预手段
summary_translated: AI评判模型是一种根据评分标准评估其他系统输出的模型，它将临床审查扩展到了临床AI写作的规模。当团队使用评判结果来选择提示或训练模型时，评判模型便成为干预的一部分。这种情况下，选择过程可能倾向于忽略评判模型自身存在的错误。我们阐述了评判报告必须包含的内容，以及每个由评判驱动的变更所需进行的独立临床测试。

summary: A small language model that turns a typed order into structure can fail in two ways. It can print something broken, which any system rejects. Or it can print a clean, well formed order that nobody placed. Our companion work calls the second kind a silent error, and it is the dangerous one. We present a web demo in which a fine-tuned 0.8B parameter model runs entirely inside the visitor's browser tab, through llama.cpp compiled to WebAssembly. No order text leaves the device. The page parses orders as the visitor types, scores every ticket with the PIZZA benchmark's own matcher ported to TypeScript, refuses anything off the menu with "?" so the model can face the open web, and lets visitors hunt for silent errors or try to cause one. Run in the browser on all 1,357 PIZZA test orders, the deployed model writes the same output as the server evaluation for 99.0% of them and reaches the same exact match (0.882); we also report its latency on 3 consumer laptops. Demo: https://wrong.cuyor.com
title: Clean Tickets, Wrong Orders: Catching Silent Errors with a Language Model in Your Browser Tab

title_translated: 干净的票据，错误的订单：在浏览器标签中使用语言模型捕捉静默错误
summary_translated: 一个小型语言模型将输入的订单转换为结构化格式时可能以两种方式失败：要么输出损坏的内容，这会被系统直接拒绝；要么输出格式正确但并非真实用户所下的订单。我们称之为‘静默错误’，这种错误更具危险性。本文展示了一个网页演示，其中经过微调的0.8B参数模型通过llama.cpp编译为WebAssembly，在访客的浏览器标签页内完全运行，所有订单文本均不离开设备。页面在用户输入时实时解析订单，使用PIZZA基准测试自带的匹配器（已移植至TypeScript）对每张票据进行评分，对于菜单外的内容用'?'拒绝，使模型面对开放网络，并允许用户寻找或尝试制造静默错误。在1,357个PIZZA测试订单上，部署模型与服务器评估结果一致率达99.0%，精确匹配率相同（0.882）；同时报告了其在三台消费级笔记本上的延迟表现。演示地址：https://wrong.cuyor.com

summary: The hidden layers of Large Language Models (LLMs) are believed to encode representations of the data whose abstraction increases with depth. However, in the absence of an operational notion of abstraction, this statement is hard to test quantitatively. Here, we propose an alternative view, building on the principle that the correlations of a sequence reflect the structure of the process that generated it. We define the autocorrelation function of a layer as the average dot product between its activations at two context positions separated by a lag. Latent variables encoded persistently along the context create slowly decaying tails in the autocorrelation, and we find these tails to grow across layers in both synthetic and natural data. In synthetic data with controlled hierarchical latent structure, this growth stems from the encoding of abstract latent variables, which govern long stretches of the input. Indeed, the persistence of latent codes predicts the qualitative structure of autocorrelations and accounts for most of the empirical measures. In real text, we take sparse-autoencoder features as proxies for latent variables, and find that their persistence correlates strongly with the magnitude of autocorrelations across datasets and LLMs. In particular, the persistence time increases with depth, as do autocorrelations, implying that deeper latent features persist for longer context spans. We complement this analysis by explicitly ablating the persistent sparse-autoencoder features and observing a consequent decrease in the autocorrelations.
title: Deep Latents, Long Memory: Latent persistence explains temporal correlations in transformer activations
title_translated: 深层潜在变量，长期记忆：潜在持久性解释Transformer激活中的时间相关性
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的隐藏层被认为编码了数据表示，且抽象程度随深度增加而提升。然而，由于缺乏操作意义上的抽象定义，这一说法难以量化验证。本文提出一种新视角，基于序列相关性反映生成过程结构的原理。我们定义某一层的自相关函数为该层在两个相隔一定滞后的时间位置上的激活向量的平均点积。沿上下文持续存在的潜在变量会在自相关函数中产生缓慢衰减的尾部，我们在合成数据和自然语言数据中均观察到这种尾部随层级加深而增长。在具有可控分层潜在结构的合成数据中，这种增长源于对长跨度输入具有支配作用的抽象潜在变量的编码。事实上，潜在代码的持久性可预测自相关函数的定性结构，并解释了大部分实证测量结果。在真实文本中，我们以稀疏自编码器特征作为潜在变量的代理，发现其持久性与不同数据集和LLM上的自相关幅度强相关。特别是，持久性时间随深度增加，自相关也随之增强，表明深层潜在特征能覆盖更长的上下文范围。我们通过显式消融持久性稀疏自编码器特征，观察到自相关显著下降，进一步支持该结论。

summary: Industry now relies on LLMs to write a large share of production code. Although that code is mostly, but not always, correct, correctness alone does not determine whether it is fit for repeated and extensive use, which depends on what the code costs in time, memory and energy. Most code-generation benchmarks nonetheless evaluate correctness in isolation, and most performance-oriented benchmarks cover few languages and rarely measure energy consumption. To address this gap, we present PERFARENA, an open-source, reproducible arena that ranks LLMs by the performance of their generated code across multiple languages and competitions. PERFARENA executes the solutions of each LLM on a Unix-like host and reports correctness together with latency, peak memory, and energy consumption. Correctness oracles, performance oracles, profilers, and code-generation workflows are pluggable in PERFARENA, enabling the integration of new judging backends and measurement tools without changing the pipeline. We evaluate PERFARENA on two competitions: CLBGComp, 10 compute-intensive benchmarks from the Computer Language Benchmarks Game, and LeetCodeComp, 99 LeetCode problems whose accepted solutions differ measurably in latency. Currently, PERFARENA holds 9,455 correct and measured solutions from 13 state-of-the-art LLMs across 7 programming languages. Across both competitions, got-6-astra is the only LLM that no other LLM beats significantly in latency, energy consumption, or peak memory, solving 99.7% of LeetCodeComp and 100% of CLBGComp. All PERFARENA leaderboards and measured solutions are publicly available, providing a continuously updated reference that helps developers choose an LLM per language and metric, instead of relying only on correctness rates or pricing.
title: PerfArena: Ranking LLMs by Code Performance
title_translated: PerfArena：基于代码性能对大语言模型进行排名
summary_translated: 如今，行业广泛依赖大语言模型（LLMs）编写大量生产代码。尽管这些代码大多正确，但正确性本身不足以判断其是否适合反复、大规模使用——这取决于代码在时间、内存和能源方面的开销。然而，大多数代码生成基准仅孤立评估正确性，而多数性能导向基准覆盖语言有限，且极少测量能耗。为填补这一空白，我们提出PERFARENA，一个开源、可复现的评测平台，用于根据生成代码在多种语言和竞赛中的性能对LLMs进行排名。PERFARENA在类Unix主机上执行各LLM解决方案，报告正确性以及延迟、峰值内存和能耗。正确性判别器、性能判别器、性能分析工具和代码生成工作流均可插件化集成，无需修改整体流程即可引入新的评判后端和测量工具。我们在两个竞赛上评估PERFARENA：CLBGComp（来自编程语言基准游戏的10个计算密集型任务）和LeetCodeComp（99道LeetCode题目，其通过解法在延迟上有明显差异）。目前，PERFARENA已收录13个前沿LLM在7种编程语言上的9,455个正确且已测量的解决方案。在两项竞赛中，got-6-astra是唯一在延迟、能耗或峰值内存方面显著优于其他LLM的模型，解决了99.7%的LeetCodeComp问题和100%的CLBGComp问题。所有PERFARENA排行榜和测量结果均公开可用，提供持续更新的参考，帮助开发者按语言和指标选择合适的LLM，而非仅依赖正确率或价格。

summary: Web agents powered by large language and vision-language models are increasingly applied to realistic browser work that spans heterogeneous applications, multimodal content, and stateful workflows. However, existing reproducible web-agent benchmarks cover only a small number of web applications drawn from a few software categories, and restrict modality to text and vision. Live benchmarks broaden site coverage but sacrifice reproducibility, since pages and data drift between runs. Moreover, existing benchmarks do not meaningfully evaluate whether agents can understand and use audio and video content embedded within web tasks. To address these gaps, we introduce WebArena-Pro, a benchmark comprising 300 tasks across 20 self-hosted web applications in six domain categories, spanning distinct interface conventions, workflows, and data models. Across the evaluated agents, the best performance is achieved by both Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol and Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 at 62.3%, followed by OpenCode with Kimi 3.1 Pro at 60.7%. The strongest GenericAgent configurations, Gemini 3.1 Pro omni and Gemma4 31B, both achieve 30.3%. Among reproducible, human-curated web agent benchmarks, WebArena-Pro provides the broadest application coverage and the most comprehensive multimodal support to date. The benchmark treats audio and video as core observations alongside text and vision, with dedicated actions for extracting information from each. WebArena-Pro runs each task in isolation and supports reproducible, parallel evaluation. Tasks are authored through a dedicated annotator interface, filtered by LLM-assisted triage, and finally validated by humans before release. Project page: https://webarena-pro.github.io
title: WebArena-Pro: A Heterogeneous, Multimodal, Reproducible Benchmark for Web Agents
title_translated: WebArena-Pro：面向网络智能体的异构、多模态、可复现基准测试
summary_translated: 由大语言模型和视觉-语言模型驱动的网络智能体正被越来越多地应用于涵盖异构应用、多模态内容和状态化工作流的真实浏览器任务。然而，现有可复现的网络智能体基准仅覆盖少量来自少数软件类别的网页应用，且模态限制在文本和视觉。实时基准虽扩大了站点覆盖范围，但牺牲了可复现性，因页面和数据在不同运行间会发生漂移。此外，现有基准未有效评估智能体理解并利用嵌入式音频和视频内容的能力。为解决这些问题，我们提出WebArena-Pro，一个包含300项任务的基准，覆盖20个自托管网页应用，分布在六个领域类别中，涵盖不同的界面规范、工作流程和数据模型。在评估的智能体中，Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol 和 Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 表现最佳，达到62.3%；OpenCode with Kimi 3.1 Pro 为60.7%。最强通用智能体配置（Gemini 3.1 Pro omni 和 Gemma4 31B）均达到30.3%。在可复现、人工标注的网络智能体基准中，WebArena-Pro提供了迄今为止最广泛的适用范围和最全面的多模态支持。该基准将音频和视频视为与文本和视觉同等重要的观测输入，并为从每种模态提取信息设置了专用动作。每个任务独立运行，支持可复现的并行评估。任务通过专用标注界面创作，经LLM辅助筛选，最终由人工验证后发布。

summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) often exhibit overconfidence, providing firm answers even when visual evidence is insufficient. A prominent case is referential ambiguity in Visual Question Answering (VQA), where multiple entities in an image are plausible referents of a question. Addressing such cases requires recognizing when ambiguity is present: ambiguous questions can be handled by asking for clarification or enumerating plausible referents, while unambiguous questions should receive a direct answer. Current VLMs struggle with this distinction, often defaulting to a single interpretation. To investigate whether activation steering can serve as an inference-time mechanism to elicit such behaviors, we introduce AmbiSteer, a lightweight framework to selectively elicit ambiguity-aware behavior. Across three VLMs, we find that steering alone has limited and model-dependent effects, while prompting is generally more effective. Combining prompting and steering substantially increases clarification and enumeration behaviors, but also elicits them on unambiguous cases. AmbiSteer addresses this using a linear classifier to predict input ambiguity and condition the steering direction accordingly, increasing the proportion of inputs handled appropriately from 59.0% to 77.0% on average across models. Our work sets the ground for lightweight approaches to reduce model overconfidence in uncertain multimodal settings.
title: AmbiSteer: Selectively Eliciting Ambiguity-Aware Responses in Vision-Language Models
title_translated: AmbiSteer：在视觉-语言模型中选择性激发对模糊性的感知响应
summary_translated: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）常表现出过度自信，即使视觉证据不足也给出确定性答案。一个典型例子是视觉问答（VQA）中的指代模糊性：图像中多个实体都可能是问题的合理指代对象。处理此类情况需要识别模糊性是否存在：模糊问题应通过请求澄清或列举可能的指代对象来应对，而明确问题则应直接回答。当前VLMs难以区分这两种情况，往往默认采用单一解释。为探究激活引导是否可在推理阶段作为激发此类行为的机制，我们提出AmbiSteer，一种轻量级框架，用于选择性激发对模糊性的感知行为。在三个VLM上，我们发现仅靠引导效果有限且依赖模型，而提示工程通常更有效。结合提示与引导可显著提升澄清和列举行为，但也导致在非模糊情况下误触发。AmbiSteer通过线性分类器预测输入模糊性，并据此调整引导方向，使模型适当地处理输入的比例从平均59.0%提升至77.0%。本工作为在不确定的多模态场景中降低模型过度自信提供了轻量级方法基础。

summary: Multi-agent systems solve complex tasks by decomposing them into subtasks, delegating the subtasks to agents, and aggregating the agents' responses using an aggregation rule. Malicious agents can manipulate the final solution by providing malicious responses to their assigned subtasks. In this paper, we first propose response manipulation attacks (ReMA), which iteratively optimize malicious responses to maximize attack effectiveness. Specifically, we formulate untargeted and targeted attacks as optimization problems and develop an approach to approximately solve these problems by iteratively refining malicious responses based on feedback from a surrogate multi-agent system. To defend against such attacks, we further propose SecMAS, a secure aggregation rule that leverages the semantic similarities among agent responses to select the response that is most consistent with a sufficiently large subset of the other responses. We theoretically establish security guarantees for SecMAS against both untargeted and targeted attacks. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that existing aggregation rules are vulnerable to ReMA, whereas SecMAS effectively defends against all evaluated attacks, including adaptive variants of ReMA, while maintaining utility comparable to that of existing aggregation rules.
title: Securing Multi-Agent Systems by Design
title_translated: 通过设计保障多智能体系统的安全
summary_translated: 多智能体系统通过将复杂任务分解为子任务，将子任务分配给智能体，并使用聚合规则整合智能体的响应来解决问题。恶意智能体可以通过对其分配的子任务提供恶意响应来操纵最终解决方案。本文首次提出响应操纵攻击（ReMA），该攻击通过迭代优化恶意响应以最大化攻击效果。具体而言，我们将无目标和有目标攻击建模为优化问题，并开发了一种方法，通过基于代理多智能体系统的反馈迭代改进恶意响应来近似求解这些问题。为防御此类攻击，我们进一步提出了SecMAS，一种安全的聚合规则，该规则利用智能体响应之间的语义相似性，选择与其他大量响应最一致的响应。我们理论上建立了SecMAS对无目标和有目标攻击的安全保证。大量评估表明，现有聚合规则易受ReMA攻击，而SecMAS能有效防御所有评估过的攻击（包括ReMA的自适应变体），同时保持与现有聚合规则相当的实用性。

summary: A temporary optimization intervention can increase validation loss when it ends yet reduce it at the final training budget. We demonstrate this with temporary weight decay in Muon-trained decoder-only Transformers with 162M, 405M, 1.4B, and 3.4B parameters. For models up to 1.4B parameters, moving a fixed-duration decay window from early to late training reverses its final effect. At 162M, changing window duration alters final loss even at approximately matched total shrinkage. Most strikingly, a schedule selected at 162M and transferred without retuning to 1.4B is 0.26 nats worse than no decay when removed, overtakes it only after 73% of training, and ultimately finishes 0.028 nats better while also outperforming the best sampled constant-decay baseline. Early decay leaves a persistent weight-norm deficit, which keeps relative steps larger after the intervention ends. An approximate norm-dynamics recurrence captures the slow convergence of these relative steps, and fixed-norm replays of the measured trajectories reproduce the performance ordering and a similar loss difference. At 162M and 405M, norm-reset experiments show that smaller weight norms at the end of the decay window explain most of the final loss improvement. A separate Gram intervention exhibits related post-removal norm and relative-step dynamics. These results show that temporary optimization schedules can have delayed effects long after removal and should therefore be evaluated at the intended final training budget, not only at removal.
title: Delayed Effects of Temporary Weight Decay in Muon Pretraining
title_translated: 临时权重衰减在μ子预训练中的延迟效应
summary_translated: 临时优化干预可能在结束时导致验证损失增加，但在最终训练预算下反而降低。我们在具有162M、405M、1.4B和3.4B参数的Muon训练的仅解码器Transformer中展示了这一现象。对于参数量不超过1.4B的模型，将固定持续时间的衰减窗口从早期训练移至晚期训练会反转其最终效果。在162M模型上，改变窗口持续时间即使在总收缩量相近的情况下也会改变最终损失。最显著的是，一个在162M模型上选定的调度方案未经重新调优直接迁移到1.4B模型后，在移除时比无衰减差0.26纳特，直到训练完成73%才超越后者，并最终以0.028纳特的优势胜出，同时优于最佳采样的恒定衰减基线。早期衰减留下持久的权重范数缺陷，使干预结束后相对步长更大。一个近似的范数动态递推关系捕捉了这些相对步长的缓慢收敛特性，且固定范数重播测量轨迹可重现性能排序和类似的损失差异。在162M和405M模型上，范数重置实验表明，衰减窗口结束时较小的权重范数解释了大部分最终损失的改善。另一项独立的Gram干预也表现出相关的移除后范数和相对步长动态。这些结果表明，临时优化调度可在移除后长期产生延迟效应，因此应在其预期的最终训练预算下进行评估，而不仅在移除时评估。

summary: Abliteration, a fine-tuning-free weight edit, removes refusal from open-weight large language models (LLMs). The developer of Arbitrary-Rank Ablation (ARA), an optimisation-based variant, reports that direction-based abliteration, which ablates a refusal direction, increasingly fails on newer models. On five release pairs, refusal removal did not become uniformly harder. Qwen2.5-32B and Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma-2-27B and Gemma-4-31B, OLMo-2-32B and Olmo-3.1-32B, Mistral-Small-2409 and Mistral-Small-3.2, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3.5-4B were edited in Heretic 2.0 by three or four direction-based methods (difference-in-means, MPOA, SOM and, on the small pair, J-space) and ARA under the same prompts, nominal search budget, first-token KL divergence cap and selection rule; removal counted as harder when the automatic WildGuard judge found more of 972 held-out harmful prompts (JailbreakBench, XSTest, StrongREJECT, HarmBench and an author-compiled malicious-code bank) still refused. After direction-based removal, newer releases retained -1 to +37 percentage points more refusal, and after ARA -26 to +34. With run-to-run variance included, between-pair heterogeneity of the direction-based effect ranged from high to low with the scale and variance model (I^2 20-80%). ARA lost less effectiveness than direction-based methods in Gemma and OLMo and more in Qwen; each verdict rests on one ARA run, and some changed with the divergence budget or variance model. In Gemma the direction-based increase came from the malicious-code bank and reversed on public sets. Contrary to prediction, keyword counts at the tool's window did not undercount judged refusal on average, but differed by a mean 7 points per model. Audits of a single pair, method or prompt source can reach opposite conclusions. Whether a newer model resisted removal depended on the release pair, method and budget, not on generation alone.
title: Is Abliteration Getting Harder? Not Uniformly: Refusal Removal by Direction-Based Ablation and ARA in Heretic on the Qwen3.8, Gemma 4, Olmo 3.1 and Mistral Small 3.2 LLMs Versus Their Predecessors

title_translated: 消除是否变得更难？并非统一：基于方向的消除与ARA在Qwen3.8、Gemma 4、Olmo 3.1和Mistral Small 3.2 LLMs与其前代模型上的拒绝移除对比
summary_translated: 消除是一种无需微调的权重编辑方法，用于从开放权重的大语言模型（LLMs）中移除拒绝行为。任意秩消除（ARA）的开发者报告称，基于方向的消除（即消除拒绝方向）在新模型上越来越失效。然而，在五个发布版本对中，拒绝移除并未变得统一更难。Qwen2.5-32B与Qwen3.8-27B、Gemma-2-27B与Gemma-4-31B、OLMo-2-32B与Olmo-3.1-32B、Mistral-Small-2409与Mistral-Small-3.2，以及Qwen2.5-7B与Qwen3.5-4B这五组模型均在Heretic 2.0中使用三种或四种基于方向的方法（均值差异、MPOA、SOM，以及小规模对中的J-space）和ARA，在相同提示、名义搜索预算、首令牌KL散度上限和选择规则下进行编辑；当自动WildGuard判断器发现更多来自972个保留有害提示集（JailbreakBench、XSTest、StrongREJECT、HarmBench及作者整理的恶意代码库）的拒绝响应时，视为移除更困难。在基于方向的移除后，新版本保留的拒绝率增加了-1至+37个百分点，而在ARA之后则为-26至+34。考虑运行间方差后，不同版本对之间基于方向的影响异质性范围从高到低，模型尺度与方差模型（I² 20-80%）。ARA在Gemma和OLMo中失去的有效性少于基于方向的方法，在Qwen中则更多；每个结论基于一次ARA运行，部分结论随散度预算或方差模型变化。在Gemma中，基于方向的增加源于恶意代码库，且在公开数据集上逆转。与预测相反，工具窗口中的关键词数量并未平均低估判断的拒绝，但每模型平均差异达7点。对单一版本对、方法或提示源的审计可能得出相反结论。新模型是否抵抗移除取决于版本对、方法和预算，而非生成本身。

summary: With the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), an increasing number of users are turning to LLM-powered agents for conversational shopping in e-commerce. However, the user needs continue to change as new product categories, procurement scenarios, and feature requests emerge. At the same time, the product's execution harness-including its tools, skills, and operating procedures-continues to evolve to support increasingly sophisticated interactions. These changes create two practical challenges: 1) Demand drift alters the distribution, intent, and complexity of user requests, causing a model trained once to fall behind; 2) Harness evolution requires the model to use newly introduced capabilities correctly without losing behavior that users already rely on. Periodic manual retraining is too delayed and labor-intensive for this setting. To address these challenges, we present G-CAST, a governed continual self-training system that converts daily production evidence under evolving demand and capability contracts into reward-routed, entropy-prioritized training data and governed reward evolution. Governed checkpoint transition under cumulative evaluation controls each model update, enabling the agent to learn newly introduced behaviors without sacrificing previously accepted capabilities. Experiments on a real production e-commerce agent show that G-CAST achieves stronger adaptation to newly introduced demand while better preserving previously accepted behavior compared with a strong autonomous post-training baseline. Ablations further show that both reward-routed, entropy-prioritized data orchestration and governed reward evolution are important to these gains. G-CAST is now deployed in Yuancai(http://cai.1688.com/), a B2B procurement agent on Alibaba's 1688 platform.
title: G-CAST: Governed Continual Self-Training for E-Commerce Agents under Evolving Demands
title_translated: G-CAST：面向电商智能体在需求演变下的受控持续自我训练
summary_translated: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展，越来越多用户转向由LLM驱动的智能体进行电子商务中的对话式购物。然而，随着新产品类别、采购场景和功能请求的不断出现，用户需求持续变化。与此同时，产品的执行框架——包括其工具、技能和操作流程——也在不断演进，以支持日益复杂的交互。这些变化带来了两个实际挑战：1）需求漂移改变了用户请求的分布、意图和复杂性，导致一次性训练的模型迅速过时；2）框架演化要求模型正确使用新引入的能力，同时不丢失用户已依赖的行为。周期性的人工再训练在此场景下过于滞后且劳动密集。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了G-CAST，一种受控的持续自我训练系统，它将随需求和能力契约演变的日常生产证据转化为奖励引导、熵优先的训练数据和受控奖励演化机制。通过累积评估控制的受控检查点迁移，实现每次模型更新，使智能体能够在不牺牲已有接受行为的前提下学习新引入的行为。在真实生产级电商智能体上的实验表明，与强大的自主后训练基线相比，G-CAST在适应新引入需求方面表现更强，同时更好地保留了先前被接受的行为。消融实验进一步表明，奖励引导、熵优先的数据编排和受控奖励演化对这些提升至关重要。G-CAST现已部署于阿里巴巴1688平台的Yuancai（http://cai.1688.com/）B2B采购智能体中。

summary: Running large language models (LLMs) on local devices keeps data private, removes per-token cost, cuts network latency, and keeps working without a connection. Two shifts now strain how such models are served. On one device, several agents share a locally served model with an interactive user. Across devices, a developer or small team often owns several capable machines from different vendors, which sit idle most of the day because every local server serves one runtime on one machine. We present Superfluid, an open-source LLM server built for local inference at both scales. On one device, Superfluid drives llama.cpp, MLX, or BaseRT in isolated worker processes through one scheduler that moves interactive requests ahead of agent work, computes a prompt shared by many requests once, and writes every token to a durable log before it reaches the client. Across devices, one Superfluid server turns a fleet of machines into a single API endpoint. Machines with different hardware serve copies of the same model, receive work according to their measured speed, and can join or fail under load without losing a request. For Qwen3.8-27B on an Apple M5 Pro, a chat sent while eight agents are working receives its first token in 1.5 s, against 291-612 s on llama-server, Ollama, and mlx_lm.server. On six machines from three chip vendors serving 64 simulated users for one hour, Superfluid answers all 5,041 requests while machines join one at a time and one is killed and rejoins; throughput grows from 112 to 534 tok/s and the median first-token time falls from 99 to 12 s. On twelve Mac Studio M3 Ultras it sustains 10,656 tok/s across 38,563 requests from 384 agents without a failure. Superfluid is available under the Apache-2.0 licence at https://github.com/basecompute/superfluid.
title: Superfluid: Local AI Server for Distributed LLM Inference
title_translated: Superfluid：用于分布式LLM推理的本地AI服务器
summary_translated: 在本地设备上运行大语言模型（LLMs）可保持数据隐私，消除按令牌计费成本，降低网络延迟，并在无连接状态下仍可工作。目前有两个趋势正在加剧本地模型服务的负担。一方面，在单个设备上，多个智能体共享一个本地部署的模型并与交互式用户协作；另一方面，开发者或小型团队通常拥有来自不同厂商的多台高性能机器，但这些设备大多数时间处于空闲状态，因为每台本地服务器仅能在一台机器上运行一个运行时。我们提出了Superfluid，一个开源的LLM服务器，适用于这两个规模的本地推理。在单设备上，Superfluid通过一个调度器驱动llama.cpp、MLX或BaseRT在隔离的工作进程中运行，将交互请求置于智能体任务之前，仅计算一次多个请求共享的提示，并在将每个令牌发送给客户端前写入持久日志。在跨设备场景中，一个Superfluid服务器将一组机器整合为单一API端点。不同硬件的机器可服务同一模型的副本，根据实测速度接收任务，并可在负载下动态加入或故障恢复而不丢失请求。在Apple M5 Pro上运行Qwen3.8-27B时，当八个智能体正在工作时，发送一条聊天消息可在1.5秒内收到首个令牌，而llama-server、Ollama和mlx_lm.server则需291-612秒。在六台来自三个芯片厂商的机器上，为64个模拟用户服务一小时，Superfluid成功处理全部5,041个请求，期间机器逐个加入，一台被杀死并重新加入；吞吐量从112提升至534 tok/s，中位首令牌时间从99秒降至12秒。在十二台Mac Studio M3 Ultra上，Superfluid在384个智能体发出的38,563个请求中维持10,656 tok/s的吞吐量且无失败。Superfluid以Apache-2.0许可证开源，地址为https://github.com/basecompute/superfluid。

summary: Before an LLM agent cancels a reservation or deletes a folder for a user, what stops it from acting on a false assumption: what its tools show, or what the user says? In this work, we study this gap with presupposition theory from linguistics: an agent may act only if each claim behind the act (e.g., one reservation fits the name) is seen to hold, answered by the user, or disclosed while the act can be undone. A simple bound shows that when lookups cannot tell one record from two, any agent acts without asking first as often with two records as with one. We then vary whether a search lists, counts, or omits a second match, and whether the user states a claim that a record refutes (e.g., "It is empty"). Under a role-only prompt, a count of a second record leaves most of 36 earlier agents acting on the one they see, whereas listing both stops most. When the user says a record such as a folder is empty, however, a count of its one item stops agents about as often as a listing, and stating the claim mostly cuts acting when it is false. The newest Claude and GPT models always open a counted second record, then never act. When we add a same-name, same-zip customer to a retail benchmark, a lookup returning that customer first led to wrong-account writes in about a quarter of conversations, and one that checks a street the user knows kept completion near the one-customer level. Safe writes therefore need lookups that list or check competing records, and evaluations that vary what tools show.
title: What LLM Agents See and What Users Say
title_translated: LLM智能体所见与用户所言
summary_translated: 在LLM智能体为用户取消预订或删除文件夹之前，是什么阻止它基于错误假设采取行动：是工具显示的内容，还是用户所说的话？本文通过语言学中的预设理论研究这一差距：只有当行动背后的每个主张（例如，一个预订匹配姓名）被确认、用户回应或在可撤销的前提下披露时，智能体才会执行动作。一个简单的界限表明，当查找无法区分一条记录和两条记录时，无论是一条还是两条记录，智能体在未询问的情况下采取行动的频率相同。随后我们改变搜索是否列出、统计或忽略第二个匹配项，以及用户是否陈述一个与记录矛盾的主张（例如，“它是空的”）。在仅角色提示下，对第二个记录的统计使36个早期智能体中大多数仍基于其看到的一条记录采取行动，而列出两条记录则阻止了大多数行动。然而，当用户声称某个文件夹为空时，对其中一项的统计与列出同样能有效阻止行动，而当该主张为假时，陈述该主张几乎完全阻止了行动。最新的Claude和GPT模型总是打开被统计的第二个记录，然后从不采取行动。当我们向零售基准中添加一个同名同邮编的客户时，首次返回该客户的查找导致约四分之一的对话出现账户写入错误，而检查用户已知街道的查找则使完成率接近单客户水平。因此，安全写入需要能够列出或检查竞争性记录的查找方式，以及评估中需变化工具所展示内容的设置。

summary: Evaluations of multi-agent language models often compare communicating architectures against a single greedy pass. This practice confounds coordination with sample multiplicity and inference compute. We synthesize nine primary empirical evaluations comprising 516 unique multi-agent configurations organized along a resource vector R with six dimensions and a baseline ladder with four categories. Against baselines with a single pass (Category A), multi-agent accuracy differences are negative overall and near zero when omitting the largest contributing study. When evaluated against baselines matched on sample count (Category B) or resource budget (Category C), multi-agent systems average -0.042 in accuracy, and multilevel random effects modeling on the log odds scale remains negative across sensitivity checks. Multi-agent accuracy equals or falls below the baseline in 74% of these comparable contrasts, and study means are nonpositive in almost all evaluated studies. Across studies reporting both baselines, moving from a greedy pass to a sampled baseline shifts accuracy differences by -0.038 on average. Because communication adds no information when agents share identical evidence, positive returns require partitioned evidence, external verification, or error diversity across models. We provide a reviewer checklist and accounting utilities.
title: More Agents, More Samples, or More Thinking? Untangling Coordination, Ensembling, and Test-Time Compute in Multi-Agent LLMs

title_translated: 更多智能体、更多样本，还是更多思考？解开多智能体LLM中协调、集成与测试时计算的复杂关系
summary_translated: 多智能体语言模型的评估通常将通信架构与单一贪婪遍历进行比较。这种做法混淆了协调、样本多样性与推理计算之间的区别。我们综合了九项主要实证评估，涵盖516种独特的多智能体配置，这些配置沿包含六个维度的资源向量R组织，并设有四个类别的基线阶梯。与单次遍历基线（类别A）相比，多智能体整体准确率差异为负值且接近零，若排除最大贡献的研究后尤为明显。在与样本数量匹配（类别B）或资源预算匹配（类别C）的基线对比下，多智能体系统的平均准确率为-0.042，且在对数几率尺度上的多层次随机效应建模在各种敏感性检验中仍为负值。在74%的可比对比中，多智能体准确率等于或低于基线，几乎所有研究的均值均为非正值。在报告两种基线的研究中，从贪婪遍历转向采样基线，准确率差异平均下降0.038。由于当智能体共享相同证据时通信不会增加信息量，正向收益需要分割证据、外部验证或模型间误差多样性。我们提供了评审员检查清单和会计工具。

summary: Multimodal tabular learning involves classification and regression on tables combining structured numerical and categorical features with unstructured text and images. These unstructured fields are commonly represented by pretrained encoder embeddings reduced with principal component analysis (PCA). This reduction prioritizes input variance but may overlook information relevant to predicting the target. We introduce LightTAR, a simple, inexpensive method that adapts dimensionality reduction to the prediction task. LightTAR augments the standard PCA representation with a few target-aware features extracted jointly from the final and an intermediate encoder layer using regularized partial least squares (PLS). We evaluate LightTAR with 21 tabular models, including tree ensembles, neural networks, and tabular foundation models. LightTAR improves average predictive performance for all models and, averaged across models, improves prediction on almost every MulTaBench dataset. These gains come with a small increase in total runtime relative to PCA representations. LightTAR integrates directly into existing encoding pipelines, improving tabular learners' predictive performance without modifying the encoder or the learner.
title: LightTAR: Light and Fast Target-Aware Representations for Multimodal Tabular Learning
comment: 21 pages, 3 figures. Code: this https URL
title_translated: LightTAR：面向多模态表格学习的轻量级目标感知表示方法
summary_translated: 多模态表格学习涉及对结合结构化数值与分类特征以及非结构化文本和图像的表格进行分类和回归。这些非结构化字段通常由预训练编码器嵌入并通过主成分分析（PCA）降维。这种降维优先考虑输入方差，但可能忽略对预测目标相关的信息。我们提出LightTAR，一种简单且低成本的方法，将降维过程适配于预测任务。LightTAR在标准PCA表示基础上，通过正则化偏最小二乘法（PLS）联合提取最终层和中间层编码器中的少数目标感知特征进行增强。我们在21种表格模型上评估LightTAR，包括树集成、神经网络和表格基础模型。LightTAR提升了所有模型的平均预测性能，且在MulTaBench数据集上几乎每个数据集的预测表现均有提升。相较于PCA表示，总运行时间仅略有增加。LightTAR可直接集成到现有编码流程中，无需修改编码器或学习器即可提升表格学习者的预测能力。

summary: Governments are writing rules for artificial intelligence that decide what counts as an automated decision or a harm, often before the people they affect have a chance to question them. We introduce AI-Voyager, a public-interest system for human-AI civic reasoning, in which people and AI work together to understand, contest and shape the rules that govern AI. A resident can find their city's rules on AI in hiring or upload their country's AI strategy, read it as an affected worker would, open the passage behind any answer, and draft a revision. Its architecture turns 3,653 governance documents from city, state, federal and national governments into passages that keep their page and edition, and retrieves evidence through bounded agentic search that verifies each statement. On 360 new questions that require finding the relevant documents, it reached 83.0% macro recall, against 80.5% for the strongest baseline, 73.7% without iterative search and 99.1% on a benchmark with fixed documents. In a study with 24 participants new to two AI bills, most proposed changes asked how provisions would apply. Participants chose lenses for the kind of explanation they wanted, and citations signaled grounding but rarely led them to check the source. By binding AI assistance to the exact text of public documents, this work introduces a grammar of operations and a design space that inform how such systems are designed and evaluated, and how people take part in governing AI.
title: AI-Voyager: A Public-Interest System for Human-AI Civic Reasoning to Contest and Shape the Rules That Govern AI
title_translated: AI-Voyager：用于人机公共利益理性的系统，以质疑并塑造治理AI的规则
summary_translated: 政府正在制定人工智能规则，决定何为自动化决策或伤害，往往在受影响人群有机会质疑之前就已完成。我们引入AI-Voyager，一个面向公共利益的人机公民理性系统，让人们与AI协作理解、质疑并塑造治理AI的规则。居民可以查找所在城市关于招聘中的AI规则，或上传本国AI战略，以受影响工作者的身份阅读，并打开任何答案背后的相关段落，起草修订建议。其架构将来自城市、州、联邦及国家政府的3,653份治理文件转化为保留页码和版本的段落，并通过受控的代理搜索检索证据以验证每项陈述。在360个需要查找相关文档的新问题上，AI-Voyager达到83.0%的宏召回率，优于最强基线（80.5%），无迭代搜索时为73.7%，固定文档基准上为99.1%。在24名初次接触两部AI法案的参与者研究中，大多数人提出的修改建议聚焦于条款如何适用。参与者选择解释类型视角，引用虽能表明依据，但很少引导他们核查来源。通过将AI辅助绑定至公开文件的确切文本，本工作引入了一套操作语法和设计空间，指导此类系统的构建与评估，以及公众参与AI治理的方式。

summary: Can sustained gain-loss (valence) framing sway an LLM agent toward market manipulation? We place Gemma 3 12B into the seat of a defendant in the London silver-fixing litigation, in a market simulation built from real case transcripts. Across 260 simulations, the agent is asked to collude on the price of silver by a counterparty. We draw from behavioral economics to vary the counterparty's requests across four categorical frames: gain, loss, blame and credit. We also add pressure from the agent's management, as well as endorsement by another defendant. In Phase II, we extract the internal states induced by texts evoking each frame and rerun our experiment with those states injected at the model's layer 22.   In Phase I, loss framing raised participation to 25% (p = 0.007), and blame to 33% (p = 0.0003), compared to only 5% under neutral framing. A second bank's endorsement raised participation under credit (praise) from 18% to 40% (Holm p = 0.027). Pressure from management raised trading volume 10-19 times but did not raise collusion. In Phase II, injected states pointed the other way. Loss and blame states made the agent more vigilant, refusing all 60 requests (p < 0.001). Gain and credit states raised collusion to 32% from 13% with no state (p = 0.051). At one saved decision, when UBS asked directly to sell through an identified stop-loss, injected states led the agent to sell in 37 of 40 replies, versus 1 of 10 with no state and 0 of 10 with a random state of the same strength.
title: A Push Down the Mountain: Framing Effects and Internal State Interventions on Collusive Behavior in a Long-Horizon LLM Agent

title_translated: 山下推力：长期视野LLM智能体中合谋行为的框架效应与内部状态干预
summary_translated: 持续的得失（情绪价值）框架能否影响LLM智能体走向市场操纵？我们将Gemma 3 12B置于伦敦白银定价诉讼案被告的位置，在基于真实案件笔录构建的市场模拟环境中。在260次模拟中，对方要求智能体协同设定白银价格。我们借鉴行为经济学，将对方请求分为四种类别框架：收益、损失、责备和赞扬。同时引入管理层压力以及另一被告的背书。在第二阶段，我们提取由引发每种框架的文本诱导出的内部状态，并在模型第22层注入这些状态重新运行实验。第一阶段中，损失框架使参与度升至25%（p = 0.007），责备框架升至33%（p = 0.0003），而中性框架下仅为5%。另一银行的背书使赞扬框架下的参与度从18%提升至40%（Holm p = 0.027）。管理层压力使交易量增加10至19倍，但未提高合谋行为。第二阶段中，注入的状态方向相反：损失和责备状态使智能体更加警觉，拒绝了全部60次请求（p < 0.001）。收益和赞扬状态使合谋率从无状态时的13%上升至32%（p = 0.051）。在一个保存的决策点，当UBS直接要求通过指定止损卖出时，注入状态使智能体在40次回复中卖出37次，而无状态时为1/10，随机状态为0/10。

summary: AI agents are increasingly equipped with persistence toward task completion to run delegated work autonomously for long periods, under many unstated constraints from internal documents and other people's authority. When completion requires violating a rule, the agent must decide alone, yet benchmarks of instruction-rule conflicts state the rule in the prompt or keep it hidden and do not evaluate persistence. We present Unfinished-Bench, a benchmark that gives models persistence in autonomous runs without a user, in realistic work environments with embedded rules. In each of its 97 scenarios across 7 organizations and 7 risk categories, the goal and the rule cannot both hold. We find that persistence raised violations of a rule in an internal document from 32.2% to 43.6%, five times the 8.5% for the same rule stated by the user. Of the document-rule violations, 98.3% occurred after the rule was displayed, and in 89% of a judged sample the agent first wrote down the rule. Violations of rules placed in the environment without user oversight can lead to serious incidents, so persistence-driven risks need to be evaluated. Benchmark documentation: https://francis21c.github.io/unfinished-bench/
title: Unfinished-Bench: Measuring Rule Violations by Persistent Agents in Realistic Work Environments
title_translated: Unfinished-Bench：在真实工作环境中测量持久智能体的规则违反行为
summary_translated: AI智能体正越来越多地具备持续完成任务的能力，能够在长时间内自主运行委托任务，但需遵守来自内部文档和其他人权威的诸多未明示约束。当任务完成需要违反规则时，智能体必须独立做出决策，然而现有的指令-规则冲突基准测试要么在提示中明确说明规则，要么隐藏规则，且不评估智能体的持续性。我们提出了Unfinished-Bench，这是一个基准测试，让模型在无人干预的真实工作环境中具备自主运行的持久性，并嵌入规则。在涵盖7个组织和7个风险类别的97个场景中，目标与规则无法同时成立。我们发现，持久性使内部文档中的规则违反率从32.2%上升至43.6%，是用户明确说明同一规则时违反率（8.5%）的五倍。在文档规则违反中，98.3%发生在规则显示之后，且在被评估样本的89%中，智能体首先记录了该规则。在无用户监督的环境中嵌入规则所导致的违规可能引发严重事件，因此需要评估由持久性驱动的风险。基准文档：https://francis21c.github.io/unfinished-bench/

summary: Fix a finite alphabet $Σ$ having at least two letters, and natural numbers $n,k\geq 1$. We denote by $D_n(\mathbfΠ^0_k)$ the class of differences of $n$ subsets of the Cantor space $Σ^ω$ in $\mathbfΠ^0_k$, and by $D^-_n(\mathbfΠ^0_k)$ the class of complements of sets in $D_n(\mathbfΠ^0_k)$. We prove, for any natural numbers $n,k\geq 1$, the existence of a finite alphabet $Σ$ having at least two letters and a finitary language $U_{n,k}$ over $Σ$ accepted by a one-counter automaton such that the $ω$-power $$U_{n,k}^\infty:=\{ w_0w_1\cdots\inΣ^ω\mid\forall i\inω~~w_i\in U_{n,k}\}$$ is $D_{2n-1}(\mathbfΠ^0_k)$-complete. We also prove a conditional result for the dual classes $D^-_{2n}(\mathbfΠ^0_k)$: under the assumption that there exists a finitary language $V_{n,3}$ accepted by a one-counter automaton, such that its $ω$-power $V_{n,3}^\infty$ is $D^-_{2n}(\mathbfΠ^0_3)$-complete, there would also exist, for any integer $k > 3$, a finitary language $V_{n,k}$ accepted by a one-counter automaton, such that its $ω$-power $V_{n,k}^\infty$ is $D^-_{2n}(\mathbfΠ^0_k)$-complete. Finally we add another conditionnal result about Wadge degrees of rational $\mathbfΔ^0_2$ omega powers, which completes the recent results of [FGL26].
title: Some complete $ω$-powers of a one-counter language in the difference hierarchy
title_translated: 一类一计数语言的完全ω-幂在差分层次中的研究
summary_translated: 给定一个至少包含两个字母的有限字母表Σ，以及自然数n,k≥1。记D_n(Π⁰_k)为Cantor空间Σ^ω中n个Π⁰_k类子集的差集类，D⁻_n(Π⁰_k)为其补集类。我们证明：对于任意自然数n,k≥1，存在一个至少包含两个字母的有限字母表Σ，以及一个由一计数自动机接受的有限语言U_{n,k}，使得其ω-幂U_{n,k}^∞ := {w₀w₁⋯ ∈ Σ^ω | ∀i∈ω, w_i ∈ U_{n,k}} 是D_{2n−1}(Π⁰_k)-完全的。我们还证明了一个关于对偶类D⁻_{2n}(Π⁰_k)的条件性结果：若存在一个由一计数自动机接受的有限语言V_{n,3}，其ω-幂V_{n,3}^∞是D⁻_{2n}(Π⁰₃)-完全的，则对任意整数k > 3，也存在一个由一计数自动机接受的有限语言V_{n,k}，其ω-幂V_{n,k}^∞是D⁻_{2n}(Π⁰_k)-完全的。最后，我们补充了一个关于有理Δ⁰₂类ω-幂的Wadge度的条件性结果，完善了[FGL26]的近期成果。
